set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import commaParam, uniqueUpper from modules::SalesBatchKeys --- commaParam(vars.salesBatchSummary.uniqueCountryCodes default [], [])]
set-variable.doc:name: codes query param

logger.doc:name: REST Countries URL diagnostics
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var qp = { codes: "ES,FR", fields: "cca2,name,region" } --- "[correlationId=" ++ (vars.correlationId default "n/a") ++ "] REST Countries | props: host='" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.host") default "<empty>") ++ "' port='" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.port") default "<empty>") ++ "' basePath='" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.basePath") default "<empty>") ++ "' alphaFields='" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.alphaFields") default "<empty>") ++ "' | codesParam='" ++ qp.codes ++ "' | queryMap=" ++ write(qp, "application/json") ++ " | queryString=" ++ ("codes=" ++ (qp.codes as String default "") ++ "&fields=" ++ (qp.fields as String default "")) ++ " | effectiveUrl=https://" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.host") as String default "") ++ ":" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.port") as String default "") ++ (p("apis.restCountries.basePath") as String default "") ++ "/alpha?" ++ ("codes=" ++ (qp.codes as String default "") ++ "&fields=" ++ (qp.fields as String default ""))]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import upper from dw::core::Strings --- (payload default []) reduce ((item, acc = {}) -> acc ++ { (upper(item.cca2 default "")): { country_name: item.name.common default null, region: item.region default null } })]
set-variable.doc:name: Response to map by cca2

logger.doc:name: Countries API failed
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var qp = { codes: "ES,FR", fields: "cca2,name,region" } --- "[correlationId=" ++ (vars.correlationId default "n/a") ++ "] REST Countries failed | effectiveUrl=https://" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.host") as String default "") ++ ":" ++ (p("apis.restCountries.port") as String default "") ++ (p("apis.restCountries.basePath") as String default "") ++ "/alpha?" ++ ("codes=" ++ (qp.codes as String default "") ++ "&fields=" ++ (qp.fields as String default "")) ++ " | queryMap=" ++ write(qp, "application/json") ++ " | err=" ++ (error.description default "") ++ " | type=" ++ (error.errorType.namespace default "") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "")]

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java import upper from dw::core::Strings var rows = vars.salesRows default [] var bm = vars.countryByCode default {} --- rows map ((row) -> row ++ (do { var code = upper(row.country_code default "") var meta = bm[code] --- if (meta != null) { country_name: meta.country_name, region: meta.region } else { country_name: null, region: null } }))]
set-variable.doc:name: Merge country into each row
